review_description: In 2011 I requested a high energy surge suppressor to be installed. There was on 230Vac line side lightning strike and consequently some of my very test equipment blew up. On investigation I found their Electrician had not come back to install the requested and paid surge suppressor.Not happy.

We wanted off-grid with Powerwall 2 batteries supplied to a new house in Woodcroft SA as soon as it was finished. None of your recommended suppliers were interested.The house was finished 7 days ago. Our Fronius Primo 8.2 was installed yesterday and the 10.5kW of solar should be finished this week.The Tesla site survey was done yesterday for 2 x Powerwall 2 batteries 27 kWh storage and 10kW continuous power and installation will be in the next two weeks.This will be the first off-grid install of Powerwall 2 in Australia.Flinn I think you may be interested and I invite you to come to the PW2 install, it is 20 minutes from Brighton. If you are interested contact us and we will tell you the address, time and date.RegardsBob
